Sarah —

Thanks again for moving this forward. We're excited to get AcmeCloud set up as an approved vendor. To speed onboarding I’ve attached our vendor onboarding form and a Redwood PO template. A couple of items we need to align on:

- Current payment terms listed on your side: Net 60 (per your standard). Our preferred cadence for strategic SaaS vendors is Net 30 to simplify AP runs and forecasting.
- Would you consider a short early-pay pilot (3 months) where Redwood can take a 1.25% discount in exchange for accelerating payment from Net 60 to Net 30? We’ve had good results with this model to smooth cashflow without changing overall contract economics.
- PO routing: do invoices need a specific PO field (we provided the AcmeCloud_PO_Template.docx) and who is the AP contact to send invoice PDFs to?

Can you fill the attached onboarding form and confirm whether AP requires invoices to be routed to ap@acmecloud.com or a different mailbox? If Net 30 is not possible, can you confirm the shortest feasible cadence (Net 45?), and whether the early-pay discount is acceptable for a timeboxed pilot.

If it helps, I can loop in Procurement and Finance to sign off once I have your confirmation.

Thanks —
